ops.target_ref: Paragraph II.C.5 (Basement) of Section II. DEFINITIONS
ops.new_text: 5. Basement. Any area of a building having its floor below ground level on all sides. A crawlspace, or an area with its floor at or above the lowest adjacent grade on any side, is not a basement.
